dedupe_keys.name: cbs curacao census 2023 neighbourhood viewer with neighbourhood maps and tables of households renters overcrowding and rates of no water or electricity supply

description: The Central Bureau of Statistics Curaçao built a static Neighbourhood Viewer for the 2023 Census, hosted on GitHub Pages. It maps census indicators on neighbourhood (buurt) polygons and shows them in sortable tables that can be exported to CSV or Excel. Among about forty indicators, the housing group gives the number of renters, the rate of overcrowding and the rates of no water supply and no electricity supply per neighbourhood, next to the number of households, average household size, population density, income, welfare dependence and complaints such as air pollution. Coverage is national for the island at neighbourhood level. Format and access: a free web page with embedded map data and table export, no registration; the Senso Kòrsou site also has geozone and neighbourhood population spreadsheets and topic publications. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: values below a reporting threshold are suppressed for small neighbourhoods; the page loads about 30 MB; the viewer gives rates, not dwelling counts by supply type. Simulation uses: spatial targeting of households without piped water or power, and vulnerability layers for hazard studies. Related records: the 2011 living accommodation tables from the same office.
